newsitem.title: UK: European cotton sees selective mill demand.
newsitem.headline: European cotton sees selective mill demand.

text.p: Mill demand throughout Europe was of a selective nature following the downturn of New York futures and the consequent easing of shipment values for several popular upland descriptions.
However, a modest business was arranged notably in Italy, France and Germany where attention centred mainly on Central Asian and African medium/better qualities for summer shipment.
The markets in Eastern Europe lacked feature, though occasional price testing enquiries were noted in Poland.
